description_en: Queries the 95th percentile traffic data of an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance that uses the enhanced 95th percentile billing method
description_zh: 调用Describe95Traffic接口查询按增强型95计费共享带宽的95流量数据
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-95-traffic --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cbwp --instance-id cbwp-wz9j19xrwf78fvz700000 --day 2022-10-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Describe95Traffic

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the resource.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Only **cbwp** is supported, which indicates Internet Shared Bandwidth
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，仅支持**cbwp**，表示共享带宽
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The date to query, in UTC+8. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

> Only data from the previous month or earlier can be queried
parameters.help_zh:
指定待查询日期，使用北京时间，格式：年-月-日。

> 仅支持查询上月及之前的数据
parameters.name: day
